gloss: prosperity and decline; rise and fall; vicissitudes

definitions.gloss: prosperity and decline; rise and fall; vicissitudes of fortune
definitions.explanation: the cycle of flourishing and withering; the ups and downs of fortune over time

examples.japanese: {栄枯盛衰|えいこせいすい}は{世|よ}の{常|つね}。
examples.english: Rise and fall is the way of the world.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}は{国|くに}の{栄枯|えいこ}を{教|おし}えてくれる。
examples.english: History teaches us about the rise and fall of nations.

examples.japanese: {一族|いちぞく}の{栄枯|えいこ}を{描|えが}いた{小説|しょうせつ}。
examples.english: A novel depicting the rise and fall of a family.

notes:
{栄枯|えいこ} is a literary word describing the cycle of prosperity and decline. It is composed of {栄|えい} (flourishing) + {枯|こ} (withering) — a metaphor from the natural life cycle of plants.

KEY EXPRESSION:
{栄枯盛衰|えいこせいすい} (rise and fall, vicissitudes of fortune) is a well-known four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}). The phrase {栄枯盛衰|えいこせいすい}は{世|よ}の{常|つね} ("rise and fall is the way of the world") is a classic saying.

USAGE:
{栄枯|えいこ} is formal and literary. It appears in writing about history, empires, families, or businesses rather than in everyday conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {盛衰|せいすい}: rise and fall (similar meaning, slightly more common)
- {浮沈|ふちん}: ups and downs (more modern, used for careers, companies)
- {興亡|こうぼう}: rise and fall (of nations or empires)
